<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 180.042, which in positive mode is most likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈179.035 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1) points to about 10‑12 carbons. An odd nominal mass (179) requires an odd number of nitrogens; a formula that fits the exact mass and the isotopic pattern is C₁₀H₇NO (monoisotopic mass 179.0350 Da). This formula also gives the expected ~10 % M+1 intensity from the ~10 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula of the molecule in the sample is C10H7NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H7NO</final_answer>
